shortDescription: Module for creating and deleting proxies, and updating existing ones.

options.name: allowed_addresses
options.description: Comma-delimited IP addresses or DNS names of an active Zabbix proxy. Supported if I(proxy_mode) is active. Set empty to clean.

options.name: custom_timeouts
options.description: Whether to override global item timeouts on the proxy level. Set '{}' to clear the value and use global timeouts. Used only for Zabbix versions above 7.0.

options.name: interface
options.description: The proxy interface object defines the interface used to connect to a passive proxy. Supported if I(proxy_mode) is passive.

options.name: local_address
options.description: Address for active agents. IP address or DNS name to connect to. Used only for Zabbix versions above 7.0. Required if I(proxy_group) is not empty. Set empty to clean.

options.name: local_port
options.description: Local proxy port number to connect to. Used only for Zabbix versions above 7.0. Supported if I(proxy_group) is not empty. Set empty or '10051' to clean or reset to the default value.

options.name: mode
options.description: Type of proxy. Active or passive.

options.name: proxy_group
options.description: Name of the proxy group that is used to monitor the host. Used only for Zabbix versions above 7.0. Set empty to exclude the proxy from the proxy group.

options.name: tls_accept
options.description: Connections from proxy. Supported only in active proxy mode. Set empty list ([]) to clean.

options.name: tls_connect
options.description: Connections to proxy. Supported only in passive proxy mode. Set empty to clean.

options.name: tls_psk
options.description: The pre-shared key, at least 32 hex digits. Required if I(tls_connect=psk), or I(tls_accept) contains the 'psk'. If you are creating a new proxy and have the PSK mode (tls_accept or tls_connect), then this parameter is required. In case of updating an existing proxy, if the proxy already has PSK enabled, the parameter is not required.
